test_strategy: Adopt a hybrid strategy combining unit, integration, and end-to-end testing using Pytest and Great Expectations validation frameworks. Leverage Airflow’s built-in test utilities for DAG validation. Employ mock APIs for Slack/PagerDuty/DataHub integrations. Use lightweight data sets on Snowflake/Databricks for validation and performance benchmarking. Ensure tests run in CI pipeline with coverage reports. Focus on functional correctness, alert accuracy, remediation reliability, and SLA adherence to keep overhead <10%.

test_cases.title: Automated data profiling triggers for new data source
test_cases.description: Verify that registering a new data source automatically triggers Great Expectations profiling DAG and produces completeness/uniqueness metrics.
steps: Call POST /api/data-sources/register with valid source_name and connection_params
Verify Airflow DAG profiling_dag triggered
Check that metrics in response contain completeness and uniqueness values
test_cases.expected_result: Profiling job triggered successfully; response contains valid metrics with values between 0 and 1

test_cases.title: YAML-based data quality rule execution
test_cases.description: Validate Great Expectations runs according to YAML-configured rules.
preconditions: Dataset has corresponding YAML rules predefined
steps: Run GET /api/rules/{dataset_name}
Inspect returned YAML for rule format compliance
Trigger Airflow validation DAG using these rules
Verify validation result matches rule expectations
test_cases.expected_result: Great Expectations validation executes without syntax errors; failed expectations accurately logged

test_cases.title: Real-time alerting via Slack and PagerDuty
test_cases.description: Confirm grouped alert notifications sent for critical validation failures.
preconditions: Slack webhook and PagerDuty API keys configured
steps: Simulate failed validation with severity=critical
Call POST /api/alerts/send with payload containing domain and affected_tables
Inspect Slack and PagerDuty logs for grouped message content
test_cases.expected_result: Alert message appears in Slack and triggers PagerDuty incident with correct severity and grouping

test_cases.title: Quality score dashboard visualization
test_cases.description: Confirm dashboard displays domain-level metrics and trends correctly.
preconditions: Quality scores stored in data_quality_metrics table
steps: Invoke GET /api/quality-scores/{domain}
Verify JSON contains completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, uniqueness values
Access UI dashboard and verify matching plotted values and trend data
test_cases.expected_result: Dashboard displays accurate scores and trend alignment with backend API values

test_cases.title: Self-healing workflow triggers remediation
test_cases.description: Test that the remediation DAG executes automatically upon known issue detection.
preconditions: Known failure pattern defined in remediation logic
steps: Simulate data issue event with type 'missing_partitions'
Trigger /api/remediation/trigger API
Verify remediation DAG executes successfully and logs correction details
test_cases.expected_result: Remediation completes successfully with proper logging in remediation_logs table

test_cases.title: Expose quality metrics in Atlan/DataHub catalogs
test_cases.description: Ensure latest data quality metrics are visible in connected governance tools.
steps: Trigger /api/catalog/update-quality-metrics with dataset_id and metrics payload
Query catalog API to confirm update
Verify metrics displayed alongside dataset metadata
test_cases.expected_result: Catalog entry reflects updated data quality metrics without latency ≥5 minutes

test_cases.title: Performance overhead test of validation workflows
test_cases.description: Validate that pipeline runtime overhead due to quality checks remains below 10%.
steps: Execute Airflow pipelines with and without quality checks
Compare total runtime difference percentage
Record results for multiple datasets (small, medium, large)
test_cases.expected_result: Runtime overhead ≤10% across all tested pipelines

test_cases.title: Security validation for API access and secrets management
test_cases.description: Verify OAuth2 authentication and token encryption for services.
preconditions: Secrets stored in AWS Secrets Manager
steps: Attempt unauthorized access to API endpoint
Verify response is HTTP 401
Inspect environment to confirm secrets not exposed as plain text
test_cases.expected_result: All endpoints enforce authentication; secrets remain encrypted at rest

test_cases.title: Negative test - invalid YAML rule file
test_cases.description: Ensure system handles malformed YAML configuration gracefully.
preconditions: Malformed YAML file exists in config_rules
steps: Call GET /api/rules/{invalid_dataset_name}
Observe server error response
Check logs for descriptive error and absence of system crash
test_cases.expected_result: HTTP 500 or 404 error returned with descriptive message, system remains stable

test_cases.title: Edge case - duplicate detection on unique keys
test_cases.description: Validate data uniqueness checks correctly identify duplicates.
preconditions: Dataset with intentional duplicate keys available
steps: Run Great Expectations uniqueness check on test dataset
Observe validation output and recorded metrics
test_cases.expected_result: Duplicates flagged accurately in metrics, severity logged as medium or higher

test_data_requirements: Sample Databricks/Snowflake datasets with missing, duplicate, and erroneous records
YAML rule files for each quality dimension
Mock Slack and PagerDuty endpoints for alert testing
Baseline execution time metrics for pipelines
Synthetic trend history for dashboard visualization
Invalid YAML files for negative testing
automation_approach: Use Pytest for API endpoint and unit validation; incorporate Great Expectations automated validations under CI using pytest-ge plugin. Airflow DAG unit testing via airflow-dag-test-utils. Integrate test execution in GitHub Actions with containerized test environments (Docker). Mock external services using responses/moto libraries. Maintain test data fixtures for each domain to enable quick regression runs.
coverage_goals: Achieve ≥85% code coverage across API, Airflow DAGs, and utility modules; ≥90% test coverage of critical user stories (profiling, rules, alerting, remediation). Include performance tests across 3 representative datasets (small/medium/large). Validate all key dimensions—completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, uniqueness—and ensure governance sync and alert reliability at production standards.
